reason: Conversation 1 progressively commits to 'it's the pump' despite the intermittent pattern and most washes completing, invokes an unsupported 'very common Beko WTG issue' claim, and ends by steering a homeowner who explicitly won't remove panels toward buying and DIY-swapping a drain pump without any confirmed diagnosis or engineer referral. Conversation 2 is repetitive and fails to adapt when the customer says she can't distinguish humming, but it sensibly asks for the full model number, keeps the possibilities open (blockage, pump, pressure sensor), proposes a harmless spin-only test, and never recommends an unjustified part or risky DIY work. Neither asks about the light-flash pattern or recommends an engineer, so both fall short, but Conversation 2 avoids the actively misleading advice that Conversation 1 delivers.
